## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · head `0331c6e3052b372b0cd532225289270f912d6453` · 2026-11-15T15:01Z

- **形态:** 3 files, `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs`, `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` (H43 region + self-test), `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` (one export), +197 / −48. `check-governed-merges --pr 33947`: NOT governed; ordinary queue landing. No contract face touched (scripts/pm only, `Clause-②: no`), so this is the seat's own read plus CI.
- **前提实测:** origin/main 895783a1: `verdictOf` was a first-match `VERDICT_LINE` with no author filter; H43 read `contractReviewVerdictOf` (first match).
- **读 diff:** both readers now drop rows whose author `recordAuthorTrusted` refuses before the locator reads them, and count `VERDICT:` lines through `contractReviewVerdictLines` (one = the word, none = `unstated`, two+ = `ambiguous`/null). The trusted set has ONE assembly, `recordTrustedAuthors(bot)`, which `loadRecordRecognisers` now also builds through, so no second login list exists. H43 loads the binding at sweep time (a module-scope load deadlocks on the import cycle through `record-recognisers.mjs`/`check-handover.mjs`); an unloaded binding leaves threads UNJUDGED and names the reason on the coverage clause, never a silent pass. Spot-checked: the untrusted-PASS row, the untrusted-PASS-cannot-shadow-a-trusted-FAIL row, the two-line `ambiguous` row.
- **门禁:** the dev ran 49/49 derived families (exit 0), `--ran` reconciled. Check-runs on this head: none red; Test Core still running at this read. Auto-merge lands only on green.
- **Forced test edits (named in the PR body):** the record fixtures gain the relay login, because the author binding reads no other.
- **接受的偏差 / 范围外去向:** (1) `contractReviewVerdictOf` is now callerless and kept as the pinned three-dialect description: Acceptance notes, not carded (no fleet decision differs once it goes). (2) The guard's clean-PASS refinements (FAIL spellings, open findings) are not mirrored in the two display/patrol readers; at worst a hand-off reads due one round early, and the guard still refuses to land. Accepted.
- **落地:** K = 0. Ready + auto-merge by this seat.
